QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied buffer. It works by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own functions
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs its own functions via the runtime setter. It calls this "the library ships one allocator of its own", which covers the in-tree-user and self-install parts of the item. It never says "only", but the claim of a single in-tree allocator comes close.
